motivation.purpose: Emotional nuance and empathetic conversational grounding for interview simulation.
research_questions: Can emotion-grounded dialogues improve persona responsiveness during user interviews?

composition.instance_type: Empathetic multi-turn conversation with emotion label and situation description
composition.slice_description: Train and validation splits from official parquet release on facebook/empathetic_dialogues (24,850 conversations, ~100,000 utterances)
composition.sensitive_content: Personal emotional situations described by crowdworkers; no private identifiers.

collection.upstream_creator: Facebook AI Research (Rashkin et al., ACL 2019)
collection.collection_mechanism: Crowdsourced on Amazon Mechanical Turk grounded in 32 emotion categories.

preprocessing.cleaning_applied: Extract dialogue turns, emotion labels, and situation context; format into structured turn objects.

intended_uses: Interview tone realism and empathetic response grounding (Phase 10).
prohibited_uses: Commercial redistribution without upstream license compliance

distribution.license_notes: Verified against Meta AI / ParlAI GitHub repository license.
